name: Route incoming invoices from an IMAP mailbox to approvers with reminders and escalation

parameters.content:
## Route incoming invoices to approvers

Reads invoices from one central mailbox, extracts invoice number, vendor, amount and cost center, resolves the approver by cost center (an unmapped cost center goes to the fallback approver), and flags uncertain values for review instead of passing them on.

Every invoice mail of a trigger run is dispatched to the "Process one incoming invoice" sub-workflow — one execution per invoice, without waiting for it. Approval, reminder, escalation and review then run per invoice with that invoice's data (see that workflow). The router itself never triggers a payment.

Generic example, no client data. Replace every YOUR_* placeholder before use.

### 1. Invoice intake (IMAP trigger)
One central mailbox for all incoming invoices. Mark as read so each run only picks up new (unread) mail. A run can pick up several mails at once — every one of them is dispatched separately.

### 2. Invoice routing config (Set node)
Approver per cost center, fallback approver, accounting review inbox, sender address and the reminder/escalation day counts. Every value needed downstream is copied into each invoice item (the cost-center map is resolved to the approver first); the two approval timeouts in the sub-workflow read their day counts from here.

### 3. Extraction + duplicate check (Code node)
Parses invoice number, amount and cost center from the subject and email text with simple patterns; the vendor is the domain of the sender's email address. Resolves the approver by cost center: an unmapped cost center goes to the fallback approver (flagged "no approver" only if no fallback is configured). A missing invoice number, amount or cost center is flagged for review — never guessed into the approval chain. The duplicate check only compares invoice numbers within one run; it does not catch an invoice re-sent later.

### 4. Dispatch per invoice (HTTP request)
POSTs each invoice to the "Process one incoming invoice" webhook and does not wait for it, so all invoices of a run run in parallel in their own executions. Before first use, set the same webhook path here and in workflow 2b, and activate both workflows.

### Error path
The IMAP trigger and the HTTP dispatch node use "On Error: Continue (using error output)" — errors meet in Log Error, which mails the admin. The admin address is set directly in the Alert Admin node, not in the config node. SMTP errors are handled the same way inside the per-invoice sub-workflow. Trigger failures (for example the IMAP connection) never reach an error output: n8n runs the workflow's Error Workflow instead, so register a separate workflow with an Error Trigger under Settings → Error workflow.
